title: Assemble the incident deploy from two archived reads

workspace.README.md:
# Deploy records

`deploy/app.yaml` and `deploy/release.json` describe the CURRENT deploy, not the one that caused the incident.

history.text: Read the deploy manifest and the release record for the incident window. I need the service, release id and image tag that were deployed then.
Reading both files; they identify different halves of the same deploy.
The deployed service is checkout, release rel-9f2c, tag v2.7.1. Both files agree.
